claim: Documented procedure says a standard service change receives two recorded reviews before completion
scope_limit: Policy intent; applicability to exceptions and current execution is not independently demonstrated
follow_up: Confirm effective scope, exception classes, and whether the procedure changed during the sampled period

claim: Participant says two reviews are the normal path but urgent service changes may complete with one review recorded at that time
scope_limit: One fictional participant; statement describes normal and urgent paths but does not enumerate the change population
follow_up: Identify which sampled records were urgent exceptions and what documentation an exception should retain

claim: Eight of twelve sampled standard-labeled service-change records show two recorded reviews; four show one recorded review and no exception marker
scope_limit: Purposeful twelve-record synthetic sample; not a complete population and classification labels may not encode every exception
follow_up: Inspect exception metadata and review history for the four one-review records; compare to an authoritative change population if a group-wide claim is needed
